recommendations.text: HRV has been LOW for 10+ days (weekly avg 30, down from 35-36 pre-treatment) with RHR 53-55 bpm (+3.9 bpm vs the 49.3 bpm pre-treatment baseline) and body battery <50. Medication lens: Benjamin is on Wegovy 0.25 mg since Aug 12 (day 24); the RHR rise began on the first injection day and the HRV drop tracks it, both inside the expected semaglutide class effect (RCT). Body battery is derived from the same HRV/stress signal, so it is not an independent second marker. Independent markers are NOT off: sleep score 78, no illness or GI symptoms logged, today's 7.28 km at HR 138.7 shows no HR-at-pace drift. Verdict: expected class effect, not a recovery deficit from training — do not gate runs on the pre-treatment RHR/HRV values. The one genuine risk to act on is fuelling: 14 days without any logged intake on an appetite suppressant. Keep morning check to pain + subjective feel; re-baseline RHR/HRV after 21 days on a stable dose (clock restarts if the 0.5 mg step happens Sep 9).
